blind.description: A stylized wooden terrarium or vivarium set atop a four-legged stand. The upper enclosure features glass panes showing murky green foliage within, framed by thick wooden posts and a hinged wooden lid with two circular brass vents. A lower slatted wooden shelf holds a small sack and an earthenware jar. The geometry is clean and continuous with no floating, melted, or broken parts, sitting directly on four wooden feet.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden box top with extended corner caps, featuring two golden metallic hinges along one long edge and two circular brass ornamental vents centered along its length.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4 feet tall (roughly two-thirds the height of the scale figure) and about 3.5 feet wide.
